description: One fixed revolution sampled from NASA/JPL's generic 15-year Gateway NRHO reference SPK and transformed to a Moon-centered J2000 state.
disclaimer: Official idealized Gateway reference trajectory; this is not an Artemis IV flight trajectory or prediction.
referenceEpochNote: SPICE ephemeris time seconds past J2000 TDB; celestial-body rendering still comes from Perilune's analytic universe, not this SPK.
